prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE background environment for a cozy grayscale e-reader RPG, to place behind the supplied hero and pet.
Reference image1 is the exact hero style reference. Reference image2 is the exact pet style reference. Reference image3 is PET's current UI/style reference. Draw a BACKGROUND ONLY, no human, animal, pet, aura or UI. The user wants their Reading Adventure hero and puppy to feel naturally together in one environment, with the same hand-drawn smooth black-contour cartoon style as PET, not a flat stock vector.
Scene: a quiet inviting clearing on a reading adventure, a simple woodland path passing through a meadow. A broad light empty foreground takes bottom 40% of picture, leaving clear landing space for a hero centered at x42% and pet at x66%, both with feet at y90%. A few large rounded tree trunks at far left and far right gently frame the scene. One simple distant hill, two small rounded shrubs, a tiny closed wooden sign at the right edge WITHOUT text and one cluster of leaves in the far-left corner. Central sky and path stay mostly white. No objects behind head/faces that create visual clutter.
Composition: landscape 3:2, eye-level storybook camera, coherent simple ground plane. Foreground characters will occupy middle 60% of frame but do NOT draw them. Keep center and bottom mostly empty. Trees sit at extreme edges, canopy only reaches top 15% and never covers central top quarter. Path's horizon at 65% image height; pale ground remains white with at most 3 short organic contour lines. Same floor-level plane across entire foreground, no steps or ledges where characters stand.
Style: organic rounded forms, clean confident BLACK outline matching reference but finer for background objects. Gray shadow shapes, white highlights, low overall visual density and high-key white surfaces. Friendly illustrated depth and soft volume like the pets' ears, not geometric vector symbols. Two to four shades of gray, gently shaded broad shapes, no gradient background. Calm and uncluttered. Background should frame rather than compete with black-outlined foreground characters.
Pure grayscale, no color, no text, no lettering, no symbols, no border, no UI, no people, no creatures, no aura, no wings, no floating sparkles, no book icons, no grain, dithering, hatch, noise, photorealism, 3D or dark large solid black areas. Entire scene complete within image.
status: New comparison candidate after user's suggestion to replace Aura with Background
